what_helped.label: Fireflies
what_helped.text: Fireflies often raise a low pulse.

what_helped.label: Dawn light
what_helped.text: Days with the dawn light are often followed by brighter check-ins (still learning).

sensors.label: Phone camera
sensors.shares: Eye openness, blinks, head angle, a camera pulse estimate and how your face moves (smiling, how much it moves, looking away, brief movements by face region, breathing) as numbers. Never images.

sensors.label: Pulse stone
sensors.shares: Pulse, breathing rate and beat-to-beat variation as numbers from the finger sensor.

sensors.label: Bedside camera
sensors.shares: A stick figure while you play. Never images.

sensors.label: Bedside light
sensors.shares: Nothing. It is one small LED on the bedside unit and only receives colours.

sensors.label: Home or away
sensors.shares: Hours at home and a count of nearby unknown devices. Nobody is identified.

sensors.label: Steps
sensors.shares: A daily step count (simulated in this demo).

clinic_sees: Numbers from your sessions compared with your own baseline
Sleep and rest pattern, simulated in this demo (there is no bed sensor)
A weekly summary written from those numbers
Never camera images, sound or messages

crisis.title: If today is heavy, you do not have to carry it alone.
crisis.text: If you need someone now, call 112 or a helpline below. Afferent is not an emergency service and is not watched around the clock.
